reasoning: 驗證目標：Page Down 請求時，整頁項目被移除，並由來自較低位置的新項目整批取代；以及清單底端的 wrap-around。關鍵情境條件：目前顯示位置在清單中段（一般值）或已在清單底端（邊界值）。為什麼這樣切：與 044 同一處置——依 R10-2 吸收同節未配置的邊界條款 4872503 並多引，以 boundary 為軸拆兩條；兩個方向由 044/045 各自承載，只驗一個方向無法排除「兩個方向翻同一邊」的實作（§7）。刻意略過：分頁粒度由 043 覆蓋；4872503 的 Radio:noSys scope 標記不一致同前，送 RD-1。

tcs.tc_title: Page Down replaces all displayed items with lower positions
tcs.test_item: When a Page Down function is requested, the all items on the list shall be removed, and the new list items from the next-lower list positions shall replace all previously displayed list items
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. A Tuner Station List holding more items than fit on two pages is displayed
5. The displayed rows start at a position in the middle of the list
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read every displayed item
2. Read the block of list items held in the next-lower list positions, below the displayed page
3. Request the Page Down function once
4. Read every displayed item
tcs.expected_result:
1. A full page of list items is displayed
2. The block of items in the next-lower list positions is identified
3. The page request is accepted
4. The block read in step 2 fills the page and none of the items read in step 1 is displayed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Page Down at the bottom of the list wraps to the top
tcs.test_item:
If a Page Down is requested and the HU is currently at the bottom of the list, the HU shall wrap-around to the top of the list

(Bottom-of-list boundary)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. A Tuner Station List holding more items than fit on two pages is displayed
5. The last page of the list is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the displayed items and confirm the last list item is in the bottom-most position
2. Read the items held at the start of the list
3. Request the Page Down function once
4. Read every displayed item
tcs.expected_result:
1. The last page of the list is displayed
2. The items at the start of the list are identified
3. The page request is accepted
4. The items read in step 2 are displayed, which places the display at the top end of the list
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
